by
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  have ha : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((r : ℂ) * B)) := by
    apply (hr.mul (forward_source_residue hW)).congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have hn : LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).2, IntegerMassRigidity.zetaOf]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    field_simp [hn]
  have ht := ha.sub ((coprimePart_one_residue Q).const_mul B)
  have he : (r : ℂ) * B - B * (coprimeDensity Q : ℂ) =
      B * ((r - coprimeDensity Q : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have hec : coprimePart Q (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B) =
      coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam) - B • coprimePart Q 1 := by
    ext n
    simp only [coprimePart, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
    ring
  rw [hec, LSeries_sub (summable_coprimePart Q
    (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1)
    ((summable_coprimePart Q
      (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs))).smul B), LSeries_smul]
  ring

namespace RHTower.WeilWorkSettledPhase

/-- Dirichlet coefficients of the actual producer, before any rigidity claim. -/
def sourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℂ := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)

theorem sourceCoeff_LSeries {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    LSeriesSummable (sourceCoeff lam) s ∧ LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) s = zetaOf lam s :=
  LSeries_dirichletExp (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam)
    (lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ) hs)

theorem summable_sourceCoeff {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖sourceCoeff lam (n + 1)‖ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ σ) :=
  summable_coeff_of_LSeriesSummable (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (by simpa using hσ)).1

theorem mellin_sourceCoeff {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    mellin (coeffTheta (sourceCoeff lam)) (s / 2) =
      sourceRemainder hW s + betaG (sourceCompletion hW) * Gammaℝ (s - 1) := by
  have h0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; norm_num [h] at hs
  have h1 : s ≠ 1 := by intro h; simp [h] at hs
  have h1' : s - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h1
  rw [mellin_coeffTheta _ (fun σ hσ => summable_sourceCoeff hW hσ) hs,
    coeffDirichlet_eq_LSeries, (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW hs).2,
    sourceRemainder, bigEG_eq h0 h1, sourceCompletion_eq_bigG hW hs]
  unfold bigG
  field_simp
  ring

/-- Actual theta inversion on the full canonical critical trace. The factor
`1/(4*pi)` includes the height substitution in the half-argument Mellin transform. -/
theorem coeffTheta_eq_remainderTrace {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    coeffTheta (sourceCoeff lam) r -
        betaG (sourceCompletion hW) * ((r : ℂ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℂ)) * expNegPi r) =
      (1 / (4 * Real.pi)) •
        ∫ y : ℝ, (r : ℂ) ^ (-tracePoint 0 y / 2) * remainderTrace hW y := by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := exists_decay_sourceRemainder hW
  have hmem : ∀ s ∈ verticalStrip (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (3 / 2), 1 / 2 < s.re := by
    intro s hs
    change 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 3 / 2 at hs
    linarith [hs.1]
  have hc : ContinuousOn (sourceRemainder hW) (verticalStrip (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (3 / 2)) :=
    (differentiableOn_sourceRemainder hW).continuousOn.mono (fun s hs => hmem s hs)
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sourceRemainder hW)
      {s : ℂ | 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) < s.re ∧ s.re < 3 / 2} :=
    (differentiableOn_sourceRemainder hW).mono (fun s hs => by
      change 1 / 2 < s.re
      linarith [hs.1])
  have hb : ∀ s ∈ verticalStrip (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (3 / 2),
      ‖sourceRemainder hW s‖ ≤ C / (1 + s.im ^ 2) := by
    intro s hs
    exact hC s (hmem s hs) hs.2
  have hi := inverse_mellin_shift (θ := coeffTheta (sourceCoeff lam))
    (β := betaG (sourceCompletion hW)) (σ := 3 / 4) (by rfl)
    (continuousOn_coeffTheta _ (summable_sourceCoeff hW (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)))
    (mellinConvergent_coeffTheta _ (fun σ hσ => summable_sourceCoeff hW hσ)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) hc hd hb
    (fun s hs => mellin_sourceCoeff hW (by rw [hs]; norm_num)) hr
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun y =>
    (r : ℂ) ^ (-tracePoint 1 y / 2) * sourceRemainder hW (tracePoint 1 y)
  have hp : ∀ t : ℝ, tracePoint 1 (2 * t) = 2 * (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by
    intro t
    unfold tracePoint
    push_cast
    ring
  have he : ∀ t : ℝ, -tracePoint 1 (2 * t) / 2 = -(((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by
    intro t
    rw [hp]
    ring
  have hint : (∫ t : ℝ, (r : ℂ) ^ (-(((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I)) *
      sourceRemainder hW (2 * (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I))) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ∫ y : ℝ, F y := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ t : ℝ, F (2 * t) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact Eventually.of_forall (fun t => by dsimp [F]; rw [he, hp])
      _ = _ := by simpa using Measure.integral_comp_mul_left F 2
  rw [hint, smul_smul] at hi
  have hfactor : (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / (4 * Real.pi) := by ring
  rw [hfactor] at hi
  exact hi.trans (congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (1 / (4 * Real.pi)) • z)
    (integral_sourceRemainder_eq_boundary hW hr))

theorem tracePoint_zero_two (t : ℝ) : tracePoint 0 (2 * t) = lineS t := by

  push_cast
  ring

    -tracePoint 0 (2 * t) / 2 = -(((1 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by

      (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs))).smul B), LSeries_smul]

namespace RHTower.WeilWorkSettledPhase

private theorem evenPart_lamLog (lam : ℕ → ℝ) :

  funext n
  by_cases hn : 2≤n <;> by_cases he : 2 ∣ n <;>
    simp [evenPart,lamLog,logZetaCoeff,evenSourceCoeff,hn,he]

/-- The literal odd forward series divided by the full forward series is the
exponential of minus the even logarithm. -/
theorem odd_source_ratio_eq {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1<σ) :
    LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) / LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (σ : ℂ) =
      (Real.exp (-sourceEvenLogarithm lam σ) : ℂ) := by
  have hs : 1<(σ : ℂ).re := hσ
  have hl : LSeriesSummable (lamLog lam) (σ : ℂ) :=
    lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ) hs
  have he := (LSeries_dirichletExp
    (show oddPart (lamLog lam) 0=0 by simp [oddPart])
    (show oddPart (lamLog lam) 1=0 by simp [oddPart,lamLog_one]) (summable_oddPart hl)).2
  rw [show oddPart (sourceCoeff lam) = dirichletExp (oddPart (lamLog lam)) from
      oddPart_dirichletExp (lamLog lam),he,oddPart_eq_sub,
    LSeries_sub hl (summable_evenPart hl),evenPart_lamLog,
    ← ofReal_sourceEvenLogarithm hW hσ, (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW hs).2,zetaOf,
    Complex.exp_sub, Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.exp_neg]
  field_simp [Complex.exp_ne_zero]

with an error bounded linearly by the distance to one. -/

    ∃ r K eta : ℝ, 0<r ∧ 0≤K ∧ 0<eta ∧
      Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, 1<σ → σ<1+eta →
        ‖LSeries (oddPart (sourceCoeff lam)) (σ : ℂ) /

The Dirichlet exponential splits into its coprime factor and the exponential
of its noncoprime logarithm. This is a convolution identity for the actual

theorem nonCoprimePart_eq_zero_of_not_dvd {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (f : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (hn : ¬p ∣ n) : nonCoprimePart p f n = 0 := by
  have hc : n.Coprime p := Nat.coprime_comm.mpr (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hn)
  simp only [nonCoprimePart, if_pos hc]

theorem valuationPart_nonCoprimePart_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    valuationPart p 0 (nonCoprimePart p f) = 0 := by
  rw [valuationPart_zero_eq_coprimePart hp]
  funext n
  by_cases hc : n.Coprime p <;> simp [coprimePart, coprimeMask, nonCoprimePart, hc]

theorem valuationPart_nonCoprimePart_succ {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (f : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    valuationPart p (k + 1) (nonCoprimePart p f) = valuationPart p (k + 1) f := by
  funext n
  by_cases hv : p ^ (k + 1) ∣ n ∧ ¬p ^ (k + 1 + 1) ∣ n
  · have hd : p ∣ n := by
      apply (show p ∣ p ^ (k + 1) from ⟨p ^ k, by rw [pow_succ, mul_comm]⟩).trans hv.1
    have hc : ¬n.Coprime p := fun hc => (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mp hc.symm) hd
    simp [valuationPart, valuationMask, nonCoprimePart, hv, hc]
  · simp [valuationPart, valuationMask, hv]

theorem valuationPart_lamLog (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (p k : ℕ) :

/-- A genuine coefficient identity, established on the half-plane of absolute convergence. -/
theorem sourceCoeff_prime_factorization {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (p : ℕ) :
    sourceCoeff lam = LSeries.convolution
      (dirichletExp (nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam))) (coprimePart p (sourceCoeff lam)) := by
  have hl {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (lamLog lam) s :=
    lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ) hs
  have ha {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :=
    LSeries_dirichletExp (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam) (hl hs)
  have hb {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) := LSeries_dirichletExp
    (show nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) 0 = 0 by simp [nonCoprimePart, lamLog_zero])
    (show nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) 1 = 0 by simp [nonCoprimePart])
    (summable_nonCoprimePart p (hl hs))
  have hc {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
      LSeries (coprimePart p (dirichletExp (lamLog lam))) s =
        cexp (LSeries (coprimePart p (lamLog lam)) s) := by
    rw [coprimePart_dirichletExp]
    exact (LSeries_dirichletExp

      (show coprimePart p (lamLog lam) 1 = 0 by simp [coprimePart, lamLog_one])
      (summable_coprimePart p (hl hs))).2

    rw [nonCoprimePart_eq_sub]
    abel

  funext n
  by_cases hn : n = 0

    (lt_of_le_of_lt hconv.abscissaOfAbsConv_le (by simp)) ?_ hn
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with σ hσ
  rw [LSeries_convolution' (hb hσ).1 (summable_coprimePart p (ha hσ).1),
    (ha hσ).2, (hb hσ).2, hc hσ, ← Complex.exp_add]
  rw [← LSeries_add (summable_nonCoprimePart p (hl hσ)) (summable_coprimePart p (hl hσ)), hsplit]

    lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ h => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW h) hσ
  have hb := (LSeries_dirichletExp
    (show nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) 0 = 0 by simp [nonCoprimePart, lamLog_zero])

rtial_series_eq_polynomial (b : ℕ → ℂ) (σ t : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :

/-- For every fixed line right of one half, the actual literal reciprocal
has mean square equal to its finite coefficient energy. Full positivity is

theorem exists_reciprocal_mean_square {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ G {s : ℂ | 1 / 2 < s.re} ∧
      (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
        G s = cexp (-LSeries (logZetaCoeff (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0)) s)) ∧
      ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 / 2 < σ →
        Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
          ‖LSeries.term (producerMobius (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0))
            (σ : ℂ) (n + 1)‖ ^ 2) ∧
        Tendsto (fun T : ℝ =>
          (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖G ((σ : ℂ) + t * I)‖ ^ 2) / T) atTop
          (𝓝 (∑' n : ℕ,
            ‖LSeries.term (producerMobius (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0))
              (σ : ℂ) (n + 1)‖ ^ 2)) := by
  obtain ⟨G, hGd, hGL, happrox⟩ := exists_reciprocal_mean_approximation hW
  refine ⟨G, hGd, hGL, fun σ hσ => ?_⟩
  let b : ℕ → ℂ := producerMobius (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0)
  let c : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => LSeries.term b (σ : ℂ) (n + 1)

    have h := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_reciprocal_square_weight hW hσ)
    refine h.congr fun n => ?_
    have hpow : (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-σ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) =
        ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-2 * σ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-σ)), ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      ring
    dsimp [c]
    rw [term_succ_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos (by positivity),
      Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_pow, hpow]
    push_cast
    rfl

  have hp := tendsto_growing_polynomial_mean c hc

    intro T

/-!
# Vanishing mean-square tests with fixed resonance response

The exact source energy produces finite exponential polynomials with mean
square tending to zero and height-one resonance response equal to one. Thus
unweighted mean-square approximation cannot support a continuous extension
of the normalized resonance functional.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology GaloisForLFunctions

def quantizationResonancePolynomial (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, p n * bohrExp (-2 * Real.log n) t

theorem continuous_quantizationResonancePolynomial (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    Continuous (quantizationResonancePolynomial p N) :=
  continuous_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => continuous_const.mul (continuous_bohrExp _)

theorem isBohrAlmostPeriodic_quantizationResonancePolynomial (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    IsBohrAlmostPeriodic (quantizationResonancePolynomial p N) :=
  isBohrAlmostPeriodic_sum _
    (fun _ _ => continuous_const.mul (continuous_bohrExp _))
    (fun _ _ => isBohrAlmostPeriodic_const_mul _ (isBohrAlmostPeriodic_bohrExp _))

/-- The critical logarithmic frequencies are distinct, so mean square equals
coefficient square norm exactly. -/
theorem quantizationResonancePolynomial_mean (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    bohrMean (fun t => quantizationResonancePolynomial p N t *
      conj (quantizationResonancePolynomial p N t)) =
        ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖p n‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  classical
  let P := quantizationResonancePolynomial p N
  have hc : Continuous P := continuous_quantizationResonancePolynomial p N
  have ha : IsBohrAlmostPeriodic P := isBohrAlmostPeriodic_quantizationResonancePolynomial p N
  have hcoef (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
      bohrCoefficient P (-2 * Real.log j) = p j := by
    rw [show P = fun t => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      p n * bohrExp (-2 * Real.log n) t from rfl, bohrCoefficient_trigPoly]
    have hinj (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
        -2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) = -2 * Real.log j ↔ n = j := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hlog : Real.log (n : ℝ) = Real.log j := by linarith
        have he := congrArg Real.exp hlog
        rw [Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1; omega)),
          Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < j by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1; omega))] at he
        exact_mod_cast he
      · rintro rfl
        rfl
    calc
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, if n = j then p n else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => by simp only [hinj n hn]
      _ = p j := by simp [hj]
  have hsplit : (fun t => P t * conj (P t)) = fun t =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, conj (p n) * (P t * bohrChar (-2 * Real.log n) t) := by
    funext t
    change P t * conj (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, p n * bohrExp (-2 * Real.log n) t) = _
    rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => by rw [map_mul, conj_bohrExp]; ring
  change bohrMean (fun t => P t * conj (P t)) = _
  rw [hsplit, bohrMean_sum (F := fun n => fun t =>
    conj (p n) * (P t * bohrChar (-2 * Real.log n) t)) _
    (fun n _ => continuous_const.mul (hc.mul (continuous_bohrChar _)))
    (fun n _ => isBohrAlmostPeriodic_const_mul _ (isBohrAlmostPeriodic_mul_bohrChar hc ha _))]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  rw [bohrMean_const_mul (f := fun t => P t * bohrChar (-2 * Real.log n) t)
    _ (hc.mul (continuous_bohrChar _))
    (isBohrAlmostPeriodic_mul_bohrChar hc ha _)]
  change conj (p n) * bohrCoefficient P (-2 * Real.log n) = _
  rw [hcoef n hn, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

/-- A sequence of actual critical resonance tests has vanishing mean square,
while its normalized source response is eventually exactly one. -/
theorem exists_quantization_resonance_discontinuity {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ,
